changelog.zh: 对应官方 v2.3.8；K 池等其它矿池抽水 1%，PF 池 0%。日志写不动时（例如日志盘不再响应）不再拖住矿池重连，也不会让矿工退不出、无法被重启；没写完整的份额证明不再记到显卡头上。
changelog.en: Matches the official v2.3.8. Miner fee 1% on K Pool and other pools; 0% on PF Pool. A stuck log (for example a log disk that stops responding) can no longer hold up pool reconnects or keep the miner from exiting and being restarted; a share proof that could not be written in full no longer counts against the GPU.
